obligations.source_text: the rent payable by the Tenant to the House Owner shall be Rs. 18,000/- (Rupees Eighteen Thousand only) per month

obligations.description: Pay rent on or before the 5th day of each month
obligations.source_text: payable on or before the 5th day of every succeeding month

obligations.description: Pay maintenance charges to apartment association
obligations.source_text: in addition to maintenance charges payable to Sai Residency Apartment Association

obligations.description: Pay electricity charges as per meter reading
obligations.source_text: the Tenant shall pay electricity charges as per meter readings directly to the Electricity Board

obligations.description: Pay water consumption charges based on usage
obligations.source_text: Water consumption charges based on usage shall be paid by the Tenant

obligations.description: Refund security deposit after adjusting dues
obligations.source_text: The said amount shall be returned at the time of vacating the premises after adjusting rent dues, electricity charges, water charges, maintenance charges and cost of damages

obligations.description: Pay property tax and water tax
obligations.source_text: property tax, water tax and sewerage tax shall be paid by the House Owner

obligations.description: Ensure minimum stay of six months
obligations.source_text: the Tenant agrees to a minimum stay of six months

obligations.description: Give two months prior notice before vacating
obligations.source_text: The Tenant shall give two months’ prior notice before vacating the premises

obligations.description: Not sublet or use premises for non-residential purposes
obligations.source_text: The Tenant shall not sublet or assign the premises... used strictly for residential purposes only
the House Owner or his authorized representative shall have the right to inspect the premises at reasonable times with prior intimation

obligations.description: Not keep pet animals in the premises
obligations.source_text: the Tenant shall not keep any pet animals in the premises

penalties.condition: Tenant vacates without giving two months notice
penalties.source_text: In case of shorter notice, the Tenant shall pay two months’ rent as compensation

risk_flags.description: Tenant is bound by a minimum stay of six months
risk_flags.source_text: the Tenant agrees to a minimum stay of six months

risk_flags.description: Two months rent payable if tenant vacates without sufficient notice
risk_flags.source_text: In case of shorter notice, the Tenant shall pay two months’ rent as compensation
